model.name: Krea 2 RAW Depth ControlNet
model.description: Krea 2 RAW (undistilled, CFG) guided by the depth map of a Control Image, using the Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet Control LoRA, which was trained on Krea 2 RAW. Slower than the Turbo version (28 to 52 steps) but with CFG and negative prompt control. The 862 MB depth LoRA is downloaded automatically into the Krea 2 LoRA folder.

prompt: a cozy cabin interior at dusk, warm lamp light, wooden walls, cinematic photo
